adjustment_reason: Refines route_01 based on feedback directive to constrain thickness search to 700-1100 nm and introduce optical-path difference penalty. Prior iterations showed thickness excursions beyond 1200 nm (iteration 01: 1601 nm, 1865 nm; iteration 09: 1575 nm, 1506 nm; iteration 13: 1249 nm). This revision directly addresses those deviations while preserving the 22-layer topology that achieved highest target score (0.955) in iteration 01.
